items.description: Use when the user needs X (Twitter) data through Xquik: REST API integration, MCP setup, SDK setup, tweet search, user lookup, timeline reads, follower export, media download, monitoring, webhooks, bulk extraction, giveaway draws, or confirmation-gated publishing workflows. Read-only by default, API-key only, no X login material, and every write, private read, monitor, webhook, or metered bulk job requires explicit approval.
